summary: Ran the Impeccable detector over apps/app and packages/ui markup sources, then sanity-checked flagged lines against DESIGN.md and packages/design/src/tokens-base.css. apps/app produced 14 findings (9 design-system-radius, 3 design-system-font-size, 1 layout-transition, 1 side-tab). packages/ui returned clean. Browser visualization was skipped because no browser automation tools are available in this session.
decisions: Classification of the markdown.css:71 side-tab finding as a likely false positive — it is a 3px left rule on a [data-ui='markdown'] blockquote, which is conventional blockquote typography rather than the AI-slop 'thick colored border on one side of a card' pattern the rule targets.

Classification of the three design-system-font-size findings as the strongest substantive findings — all three are 10px font-sizes, which is below the project's own documented 11px type floor in DESIGN.md.

All 9 design-system-radius findings are mechanically correct (flagged values 14, 13, 8, 7, 3, 1px are absent from the 4/6/10/16/999px token scale) but some are de-minimis (1px on 2px-wide streaming cursor / thread rail; 3px on inline diff-highlight span) or intentionally asymmetric (messages.css:53 uses 14px 14px 4px for a chat-bubble shape) — flagged as intentional-shape candidates for a reviewer rather than detector errors.
